who.label: WHO ARE WE?
who.title: Zonal NGO for Sustainable Development
who.desc: Zonal NGO for Sustainable Development is a non-governmental organization based in Chad. Founded by experts in sustainable development, our mission is to drive positive change in communities through concrete and sustainable initiatives. Since our creation, we have developed recognized expertise in local governance, environmental protection, rural development, education, access to drinking water and disaster management.
who.missionDesc: Contributing to sustainable development by improving the living conditions of vulnerable communities.
who.visionDesc: A Chad where communities live in harmony with their environment in dignity and prosperity.

history.title: Our History
history.desc: Created to meet the environmental and social challenges of Chad, Zonal NGO was born thanks to the mobilization of passionate professionals. Since its launch, the organization has multiplied field projects, gaining the trust of local communities and its partners. Each project carried out is another step towards a sustainable future.

articles.title: Launch of a new reforestation project in Guera
articles.excerpt: As part of our commitment to environmental protection, we have launched a large-scale reforestation program in the Guera region.

articles.title: Construction of a new water point in Abeche
articles.excerpt: A new drinking water borehole was inaugurated in Abeche, serving more than 500 households in the local community.

articles.title: Workshop on natural disaster management
articles.excerpt: A training workshop on disaster prevention and management brought together 50 participants from local communities.

articles.title: Hygiene awareness campaign in schools

articles.title: Delivery of agricultural equipment to women's cooperatives
articles.excerpt: As part of our rural development program, we delivered agricultural equipment to 15 women's cooperatives in the Mayo-Kebbi region.
